  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Fridge service" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>describe</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>send</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>rate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="center" name="Central fridge service center">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>select</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="facility" name="Local service facility">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>appoint</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>arrive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>repaired</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Fridge produces strange noises" />
    <bpmn:task id="describe" name="Describe the symptoms" />
    <bpmn:task id="send" name="Send the symptoms and the type of fridge to the central fridge service center" />
    <bpmn:task id="select" name="Select a local service facility" />
    <bpmn:task id="appoint" name="Make an appointment" />
    <bpmn:task id="arrive" name="Repair the fridge" />

    <bpmn:task id="rate" name="Rate the service facility" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="Fridge repaired and confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="describe" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="describe" targetRef="send" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="send" targetRef="select" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="select" targetRef="appoint" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="appoint" targetRef="arrive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="arrive" targetRef="repaired" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="yes" sourceRef="repaired" targetRef="confirm" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="confirm" targetRef="rate" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="rate" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
